metadata.name: SageMaker endpoint model latency over 1s
metadata.description: SageMaker ModelLatency exceeded 1 second. CloudWatch reports this metric in microseconds.

query.base: FROM metrics-aws_sagemaker.metrics-* | WHERE aws_sagemaker.metrics.namespace == "AWS/SageMaker" | STATS max_us = MAX(aws_sagemaker.metrics.model_latency) BY aws_sagemaker.endpoint.name

data.content: Compare model latency and overhead latency for the endpoint. 1000000 microseconds is 1 second. Check CPU and GPU utilization on the /aws/sagemaker/Endpoints namespace and scale the instance type if utilization stays high.
